## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest compatible change that solves it.

## Contract impact

- [ ] No wire-format or golden-vector change
- [ ] Additive public API change documented in the affected package README
- [ ] Wire-format or golden-vector change includes compatibility notes and updated cross-language fixtures

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run release:dry-run`
- [ ] No credentials, private tenant data, generated archives, or build output are included
